'''Tragus Rova''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], following the Coronation of Empress [[Vaylin]] he was hand-picked by her to join the new [[Horizon Guard]]. He was among the guards who accompanied the Empress and [[SCORPIO]] when they used subterfuge to initiate the [[assault on the Gravestone]]. After [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] boarded the ''[[Gravestone]]'' determined to reclaim the vessel, Vaylin ordered to hunt down the intruders. Tragus Rova located the Commander and [[Koth Vortena]] in the power generation room and attacked them, but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tragus Rova appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' Chapter III '''"Dark Reunions."'''
